title: Nonlinear tagged components with a 268-operation direct decoder

claims.statement: For the stated systematic product of sixty-two nonlinear 32-bit tagged components and one 16-bit tail with the counted direct-address decoder in proof.md, average block error for 1000 uniform information bits on 2000 independent BSC(1/10) uses is at most 499999964602496721/500000000000000000.
The same bsc-ops-v1 decoder uses exactly W=268 operations on every received word, with W<=2^(8067/1000).

experiments.purpose: Check exact nonlinear quotient and address loss counts and replay the fixed scalar schedule on sample inputs. Verify the concrete nonlinearity witness.
